checkpoint.averaging: Keep every raw checkpoint plus rolling arithmetic average of last5 complete model states, no Adam averaging. Normalization must share a compatible basis or averaging is blocked.
checkpoint.commit: No mid-update restore. Fsync state+telemetry then publish no-replace hash-bound commit manifest; directory fsync. Restore only a fully committed boundary through separately authorized phase child. Preserve first partial failure.
checkpoint.failure_limit: Crash may lose uncommitted post-checkpoint work; never claim zero lost updates or silently replay consumed work. Recovery requires new explicit authority and cumulative-budget accounting.
state: every simulator slot and core RNG

concurrency_question: Should a separately registered two-job contention/resource qualification be proposed? One MPS campaign remains the rule until Taylor explicitly changes it; prefer serial full-state phase handoffs first.

entry.exposure: Same initialization and total ancestral/additional exposure;420 is context only. Model-only historical endpoints require reproduction with full-state checkpoints if selected for continuation.
entry.rule: Both paired training replicas: positive marginal-Q1 and Mean contrasts against prospective matched current-recipe controls; aggregate paired-game-seed bootstrap lower95>0 for both metrics.
entry.uncertainty: Conditional game-seed uncertainty; n=2 training replicas is not a population confidence interval.

final_confirmation.claims: Independent confirmation of fixed endpoints conditional on two trajectories; secondary contrasts descriptive, no automatic adoption/promotion.
final_confirmation.contrasts: Primary latest-raw minus frozen-entry marginal-Q1/Mean; secondary averaged-minus-raw and each-versus420; both training replicas reported separately.
final_confirmation.early_stop: If fewer than5 completed long updates, use all available completed updates and label window length; missing valid terminal endpoints is an incident.
final_confirmation.endpoint_lock: Lock latest complete terminal raw endpoints and averaging window before opening games; no best-checkpoint substitution.
final_confirmation.models_description: latest valid terminal raw2, last5 averaged2, frozen entry2,420

health.precedence: Hard wall/resource/AC/finiteness guards override all learning rules. Budget-limited completion is not scientific plateau. Mid-update interruption remains first partial failure, no eligible complete endpoint from that update.
health.proposed_KL_stop: final full-rollout approximate KL>0.15 for3 consecutive completed updates stops at boundary; freeze/qualify threshold after tuning, before long launch.
health.warnings_only: Low entropy, negative/undefined EV and large value loss alone do not prove collapse; report alongside survival. PPO four-epoch0.03 KL stop remains independently registered unless an approved recipe changes it.

monitoring.acceptance: Read outcomes only after each strict evaluation-parent terminal acceptance; no replacement cohort after failure.
monitoring.collapse: Stop if each replica has paired-bootstrap upper95<0 for both Q1 and Mean versus that look's incumbents. Frozen-entry collapse checks require an additional approved evaluation packet.
monitoring.inference_controller: sampled K1 fixed throughout; other deployment controllers need separate registration/budget
monitoring.joint_progress: Each replica has positive Q1 and Mean differences; aggregate paired bootstrap lower95>0 on both. Update both incumbents together; reset patience.
monitoring.models: current2 plus incumbent2, all on this look's same fresh cohort; do not compare metrics from different cohorts as progress
monitoring.plateau: Stop after3 valid audited looks without joint progress. Missing/failed look is an incident, not a patience tick.
monitoring.sequential_inference: Nominal development intervals guide prespecified stopping only; not multiplicity-adjusted confirmation or causal training-seed inference.

prerequisites: Accepted S1 measurements and S2 throughput/memory parity
full simulator/wrapper/learner round-trip and next-step parity for K1/2/3/4
real telemetry parity and scheduler next-Adam-update parity
isolated evaluation and durable child-phase lifecycle
checkpoint throughput/disk reserve qualification and aggregate resource forecast
concrete recipe/init/N/T/minibatch/gamma/lambda/K/schedule/seed vectors/hard bounds and independent reviews
exact lease availability/disposition and Taylor explicit launch approval

seeds.allocation: Entry1024 +6 development cohorts of1024 +final2048, mutually disjoint. Before training, reserve exclusion ranges without opening evaluation games; final outcomes remain unread until endpoint lock.
seeds.training: Fresh non-pool stream with exclusion union, per-replica collision rejection and exhausted-space failure. Finite u32 space is not infinite unique seeds. Exclude D7/D8/D9, consumed telemetry and all prior held-out allocations; never adaptively recycle development cohorts.

supersedes: Only P4 conditional G1 long-run sketch; all Phase0/1/2 packets unchanged.

telemetry.parity: One durable complete row for every committed complete update including closing partial. Carry previous action across rollouts; exclude episode resets. EV null is valid only with its variance/definedness reason.
required: threshold hits and stops before max epoch
EV plus target variance and definedness

training.continuation: Full-state qualifying entry checkpoints required; inherited training exposure and any schedule phase transition explicit. Never resume model-only420 as if live games were preserved.
training.frame_accounting: Actual gameplay/alive/startup counters separate; keep whole closing vector step and optimize valid final partial; exact overshoot/frame-gap caps frozen with N,K before launch.
training.schedule: Carry the selected Phase1 LR/entropy algorithms and state; freeze all parameters, frame origin, maximum horizon and extension behavior before launch. Constant, cosine and KL-adaptive stay alternatives until tested; no manual rate drops.
training.target_gate: Need measured full-path forecast including I/O and20% margin within each cap. If unmet, redesign before approval; never silently extend.
training.wall_accounting: Sum all approved child-phase wall times including import, collection, PPO, checkpoint I/O and suspension/restore; monitoring has separate bounded packets. No counter resets across phases.
